name: Broadway Curb Cut Survey Data
description:
This dataset records field survey observations of curb cuts along Broadway, one of the main streets in a city corridor. Each row corresponds to a surveyed curb cut at a Broadway intersection, identified by the cross street (street_2) and a location code (curb_cut) such as NW1, NE2, or SW1, which indicates the corner and position of the cut. With 1,156 sampled rows and 13 columns, the data captures physical condition and accessibility features of each ramp.

Most columns describe measurements or observed defects. Slope is recorded in inches (slope_inch), ramp width in inches (ramp_width), and lip or bump height in inches (lip_bump_measurement_in_inches). Condition fields flag problems such as crumbling concrete, whether damage led to a pothole, and the presence of object barriers or overhead obstructions like sewers or broken asphalt.
